reason: I buy in quantity to resell. 21,000 IQD of fees on a 30,000 item kills my margin before I even sell it. The agent I already use charges me less per kilo on bulk, and I'm used to how they work.
objection: 13,000 a kilo plus 8% is retail pricing for one person buying one pair of shoes. For a shop buying 20 or 50 pieces the landed cost per piece is too high, and I see no bulk rate or fixed delivery date.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk or wholesale rate, something like under 8,000 IQD per kilo with a lower buying fee on big orders, plus a guaranteed delivery date.
